messages:
maria: Quick FYI — I'm kicking off a focused validation run for the flaky card in rack g3-s01-slot2. We need to reproduce the ECC/Xid pattern seen last week before we approve it for return to service. Planning a 2h window starting in ~15m.

kai: Thumbs. What exact tests are you running?

maria: Steps: 1) power-cycle, 2) thermal cycle to raise T by 15C 3) run continuous micro-bench + kernel-stress for 45m 4) run memtestG90 (loop) for 30m 5) run model-infer soak with 8 concurrent streams for 30m. Logs and telemetry pushed to /var/log/gpu-validation/g3-s01-slot2/

liam: Can you paste the memtest command? Want to run on another card in same rack for comparison.

maria: Sure — using our standard wrapper:
```
sudo ./tools/memtest_loop.sh --device 1 --duration 1800 --stress-level high --log /var/log/gpu-validation/memtest-g3-s01-slot2.log
```

andrea: I'll reserve the rack so we don't accidentally schedule jobs there. Also will flag the host in console as quarantined so autoscaler doesn't place new work.

ops-bot: [automation] Validation job 1718004321 started by maria — run_id=val-20240602-37, assigned node=g3-s01-slot2

kai: Heads-up — if Xid 61/43 show up, capture full dmesg + nvidia-smi -q for the last 2 minutes and upload to the incident bucket. Those codes usually point to PCI/driver blips but we should confirm memory ECC counts first.

maria: Good call. I'll add a tiny tailer script that snaps nvidia-smi every 10s and triggers a dump on non-zero ECC_SEC or ECC_ERR counters.

liam: If this reproduces, what's rollback? Immediate drain + reimage, or mark as RMA?

maria: Triage flow: reproduce -> collect telemetry -> run synthetic workloads on sibling card -> if errors are consistent across runs, mark RMA candidate (escalate to hw-team). If intermittent / thermal, we'll keep the node out of service, schedule extended burn (24h) and run with different power cable + PCI reseat.

andrea: I'll add a note to the node in console: "validation in progress — do not schedule" and set capacity to 0 for autoscaling.

ops-bot: [automation] Telemetry collector enabled for run_id=val-20240602-37, dd-agent path=/var/log/gpu-validation/val-20240602-37/*

maria: If anyone is free, please watch the telemetry channel for the next 45m. If we get spikes in ECC or Xid errors, ping hw-oncall and start the PCI reseat play.

sre-oncall: I'm on standby. If we see repeating Xid at ~10-20s intervals, prepare to pull the card for thermal imaging.

kai: Also capture pciestats before and after the thermal cycle: `pcie_health -c` output saved. We had a case where a faulty switch caused similar symptoms.

maria: Noted. I'll post logs and an initial summary in this thread when the run completes. If anything weird happens mid-run I'll call a quick huddle in #eng-infra. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
